faqs.a:
(a)
The city may extend and maintain any existing public sewer or any district sewer main
               wherever acquired from its outlet to any point within or without the city.
(b)
Such sewer extensions shall be established and acquired at such times, in such locations
               within or without the city, to such extent, with such dimensions and materials and
               in accordance with such full details and specifications as may be prescribed by the
               council.
(c)
Necessary lands and rights-of-way may upon the order of the council be purchased,
               condemned or otherwise acquired on behalf of the city, and the whole cost of such
               sewer rights-of-way may be paid by the city solely or partially by assessment, or
               otherwise.
(Code 1981, § 27-131; Ord. No. 551, § 72, 5-14-1964)
